bagPolicy.summary: Concerto hasn't confirmed Williams-Brice Stadium's bag policy details from an official source yet. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: For Gamecocks football games, parking lots include Gamecock Park, Woodstock, and the Fairgrounds, and parking can be bought in advance online. Any remaining single-game parking is sold first come, first served at the gate on gameday. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Williams-Brice Stadium. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: For Gamecocks football games, concession stands do not accept cash, and reverse ATMs on West Main and East Ground convert cash to a debit card. Outside food is not allowed, but you can bring one empty clear plastic disposable water bottle and fill it at bottle filling stations.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair seating is available, and guests with disabilities can use the elevators throughout the stadium. Deaf or hard of hearing guests can use the open captioning on the North end zone video board. Service animals are allowed.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not permitted at Williams-Brice Stadium, and tickets can only be scanned once. This policy is written for Gamecocks football games, so check your event page for concerts.
